title: Import workflows from JSON
description: Lets editors import a workflow file produced by the export endpoint. Steps are polymorphic (EmailStep, WebhookStep, DelayStep), so the payload carries `$type` metadata and Json.NET restores the concrete types.

expected_issues.description: `TypeNameHandling.All` on a request body lets the caller choose which .NET types get instantiated, a known remote-code-execution vector via gadget types. Restrict types with a `SerializationBinder` allow-list of step types, or use an explicit discriminator.
